summary: Black draped ribbon lay shadows bare in time spinning still dirge of stolen futures cemented in past shadows casting light on a journal splayed open closed to her clock's hidden whispers #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Black draped
ribbon
lay
shadows
bare in
time
   spinning
still

  dirge of
stolen futures
cemented in past
shadows
casting
light
on a
journal splayed
open
  closed to
her clock's
hidden whispers
#smallpoems
